description: Create a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) from a JSON sample. Every item in an array is read, so required, optional and nullable properties are worked out, and strings that are all dates, emails, URLs or UUIDs get a format.

json.description: A JSON sample, such as an API response.

strict.description: Add additionalProperties: false to every object.

name: generate_json_schema
title: Generate a JSON Schema from JSON
